international.title: DEA allowed 1.4m fentanyl pills to be ‘walked’ into US during sting operation, report alleges
international.summary: Investigation finds DEA permitted the pills to be trafficked during a New Mexico sting operation The US Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) allowed 1.4m fentanyl pills to be “walked” into the country during a New Mexico sting operation, billed as the largest in the bust in US history, a new report has alleged. An investigation by the Associated Press found that the DEA permitted the pills to be trafficked between August 2024 and April 2025. The new figure is far more than 74,000 fentanyl pills previously reported. Continue reading...
